# Single image for all three Node processes in the stack: the HTTP API
# (start:core_backend), the pg-boss job worker (start:worker) and the one-shot
# DB migrator (start:migrate). The compose file runs the same image and only
# swaps the `command`, so build + cache are shared across backend/worker/migrate.
#
# Build context is `backend/` (see docker-compose.yml in the repo root). The image mirrors
# ml-service/Dockerfile's co-located convention.

# ---- Stage 1: Install all dependencies ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
COPY workspaces/backend-api-types/package.json ./workspaces/backend-api-types/
COPY workspaces/backend-utils/package.json ./workspaces/backend-utils/
COPY workspaces/database/package.json ./workspaces/database/
COPY workspaces/core-backend/package.json ./workspaces/core-backend/
COPY workspaces/database-migrator/package.json ./workspaces/database-migrator/

RUN npm ci

# ---- Stage 2: Build TypeScript ----
FROM deps AS build

COPY tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json ./
COPY workspaces/ ./workspaces/

RUN npm run build

# ---- Stage 3: Production image ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS production

WORKDIR /app

# ffmpeg is used by core-backend for video frame extraction (see videoFrames.ts).
# mupdf-tools (mutool) + tesseract-ocr are used by the assignment OCR pipeline
# (see utils/ocr/ocr.ts); the `deu` traineddata is required by its `-l deu` flag.
# wget is used by the compose healthcheck.
RUN apk add --no-cache ffmpeg mupdf-tools tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-data-deu wget

COPY --from=deps /app/package.json /app/package-lock.json ./
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/backend-api-types/package.json ./workspaces/backend-api-types/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/backend-utils/package.json ./workspaces/backend-utils/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/database/package.json ./workspaces/database/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/core-backend/package.json ./workspaces/core-backend/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/database-migrator/package.json ./workspaces/database-migrator/

RUN npm ci --omit=dev

COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/backend-api-types/dist/ ./workspaces/backend-api-types/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/backend-utils/dist/ ./workspaces/backend-utils/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/database/dist/ ./workspaces/database/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/core-backend/dist/ ./workspaces/core-backend/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/database-migrator/dist/ ./workspaces/database-migrator/dist/

# Media storage for locally-persisted technical term images & videos. The
# compose file mounts a named volume here; the directory matches the default
# MEDIA_STORAGE_DIR env var.
#
===
# Next.js dashboard. Build context is the REPO ROOT (see docker-compose.yml there)
# because the dashboard depends on the backend workspace package
# `@daz-pilot/daz-pilot-backend-api-types` via a `file:` path. That package must
# be built first so the `file:` install resolves to compiled output.

# ---- Stage 1: Build the shared api-types package ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS apitypes

WORKDIR /repo/backend

COPY backend/package.json backend/package-lock.json ./
COPY backend/workspaces/backend-api-types/package.json ./workspaces/backend-api-types/
COPY backend/workspaces/backend-utils/package.json ./workspaces/backend-utils/
COPY backend/workspaces/database/package.json ./workspaces/database/
COPY backend/workspaces/core-backend/package.json ./workspaces/core-backend/
COPY backend/workspaces/database-migrator/package.json ./workspaces/database-migrator/

RUN npm ci

COPY backend/tsconfig.base.json backend/tsconfig.json ./
COPY backend/workspaces/backend-api-types/ ./workspaces/backend-api-types/

RUN npm run build --workspace=@daz-pilot/daz-pilot-backend-api-types

# ---- Stage 2: Install dashboard deps & build ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS build

WORKDIR /repo/dashboard

# The `file:` dependency resolves to ../backend/workspaces/backend-api-types, so
# the built package must sit at that path before `npm ci`.
COPY --from=apitypes /repo/backend/workspaces/backend-api-types /repo/backend/workspaces/backend-api-types

# .npmrc sets `install-links=true`, which makes npm copy the `file:` dependency
# into node_modules (instead of symlinking). The lockfile was generated with this
# setting, so npm ci needs it to stay in sync — and it makes the build/runtime
# self-contained (no symlink to the backend workspace at runtime).
COPY dashboard/package.json dashboard/package-lock.json dashboard/.npmrc ./
RUN npm ci

COPY dashboard/ ./

# next.config.ts runs validateEnv() at build time, so every URL in envSchema must
# be present. NEXT_PUBLIC_* is inlined into the client bundle, so these must point
# at the host-facing URLs. Override via build args if needed.
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=$NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN
ENV CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=$NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN

RUN npm run build

# ---- Stage 3: Production runtime (next start) ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS production

WORKDIR /repo/dashboard

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000

# install-links=true copied api-types into node_modules, so the built app is
===
# Backup sidecar: pg_dump, Qdrant snapshot HTTP, media tar, age, scheduled via supercronic.
FROM alpine:3.22

RUN apk add --no-cache \
	age \
	bash \
	ca-certificates \
	coreutils \
	curl \
	findutils \
	jq \
	postgresql17-client \
	supercronic \
	tar \
	tzdata

COPY common.sh backup.sh restore.sh entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/backup.sh /usr/local/bin/restore.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh \
	&& chmod 644 /usr/local/bin/common.sh

# /media is the shared media_data volume. Docker seeds a named volume's root
# ownership from the image directory of whichever container mounts it first, and
# this service reaches `healthy` deps long before the backend does (which waits
# for the ml-service model download). Without this directory the volume would be
# created root-owned and the backend, running as uid 1000, could not write to it.
RUN mkdir -p /media && chown 1000:1000 /media

WORKDIR /backups
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
